title: Boyd Gaming Thesis Reaffirmed: False Alert Triggered by BYDDY Ticker Collision
what_was_before: Boyd Gaming Corporation presents an attractive risk-reward profile backed by a resilient regional casino moat, high property operating margins (~40%), and aggressive share repurchases ($150M/quarter). While destination Las Vegas properties face transient visitation softness and construction friction, Midwest & South operations, online casino expansion, and managed fee growth (Sky River) provide steady cash flow. Deducting maintenance CapEx ($250M) and SBC yields normalized Owner Earnings of ~$7.85/share, supporting an intrinsic value of $98.50.
what_changes_now: A primary source audit confirms that the $11.30 alert breach was a false automated alert caused by an external data feed cross-contamination with Chinese EV maker BYD Co., Ltd. (OTC: BYDDY). Boyd Gaming Corporation (NYSE: BYD) trades at $83.42, delivering resilient Q2 2026 results with $1.03B revenue, $1.93 EPS, 40% operating margins, and $650M+ in planned 2026 shareholder returns. Normalized Owner Earnings of $8.36/share support our $98.50 fair value estimate, maintaining a solid margin of safety.
